parameters.note: 'Echo Lakes' is the collective name for the Upper and Lower Echo Lakes near Echo Summit, above U.S. 50 (El Dorado Co.); there is no single GNIS feature for the plural group, so gnisId is null and the coordinates are placed inside Upper Echo Lake (GNIS 268607). It is not listed in CCR §7.40(b) or §7.50(b), so the water falls under the general statewide lake regulation in §5.85(a)(1). CDFW's 2026 Provisional Stocking Document lists only 'Echo Lake, Lower' (recorded separately), not Upper Echo Lake, so no stocking schedule is recorded here.

candidates.summary: Open all year (general statewide lake regulation; not listed as a special-regulation water)
